defects.what: The designer does not look like the source. Positions match: iris, pencil, teeth and drops are within about 5 px. The drawing itself reads cartoonish and angry, where the source is a fine, gaunt manga face that looks terrified. (a) Brows are thick black bars (~20 px): left x≈840–945, y≈185–215, tilted down toward the centre; right x≈1120–1255, y≈180–210. The source brows are thin (6–8 px), raised and nearly level at y≈205–230 (left x≈767–907, right x≈1127–1297). (b) The dark eye rings are missing. The source has hatched crescents about 40 px tall under both lower lids (y≈355–400) and cross-hatched inner sockets; the render is plain white there. (c) The eye openings are flat almonds about 75 px tall with a doubled lower lid, and the irises are about 55 px with a heavy dark ring. The source eyes are rounder, about 100 px tall with white above and below the iris, and the irises are about 70 px, lighter and finely striated. (d) The nose is two solid black oval nostrils at (1005,585) and (1090,585) plus hatch marks. The source nose has a drawn bridge from y≈420, a rounded tip and outlined alae (x≈968–1133, y≈500–605), and its nostrils are not solid black. (e) There is scratchy horizontal hatching on both cheeks (x≈720–900 and 1200–1330, y≈380–470) and dense cross-hatch scribbles beside the nose bridge; the source cheeks are clean. (f) The face is broader and squarer, the upper lip is only a line, the chin contour is missing, and the pencil ferrule is a checkered block.
defects.fix: Redraw the features in designer.js (stare, look and soft layers). Make the brows 6–8 px tapered strokes, raised to y≈210–225 and near level. Add value-painted, hatched rings under each eye (a crescent about 40 px tall, value ~0.35–0.5, strokes following the socket). Enlarge the eye openings to ~100 px tall and the irises to ~70 px with radial striation and a lighter ring. Replace the nostril blobs with a line-drawn nose: bridge sides, tip and alae over x 968–1133, y 420–605. Delete the cheek and between-brow scribbles. Add a full upper lip and a chin contour below the pencil. Re-check against the tone fit afterwards.

defects.at: 16.20–19.12 (flying owl); owl.js / owlInk flyFront, shot.js OWL_SOFT
defects.what: The flying owl reads as a soft white cut-out rather than the source's crisp inked bird. (a) The headphone cups are thin pale-grey rings; the source cups are large, dark and ribbed. The same is true on the sitting owl at 14.44–16.2. (b) The feet are tiny grey squiggles. The source has white talons with dark outlines, about 40 px, dangling under the body, so the render's silhouette ends 20–40 px higher (455–477 bbox bottom −30 to −40; at f462 the lowest point is y 526 vs 551). (c) The wings are lumpy stacks of scalloped ovals with no outline. The source wings have smooth leading edges, long primaries split by dark lines and grey undersides. The left wing tip reaches 30–45 px too far left (f428: x 967 vs 1011; f462: 1193 vs 1222). (d) There is no dark contour on the body, which is flat white, and blur is added on top (OWL_SOFT0 0.5 plus up to 1.4 px). Edge energy in the owl region is 0.70–0.80 of the source at 442–474. (e) The body is too small: at f462 it is ~238 px wide vs ~273 px and ~30 px shorter. (f) Position wobbles against the source: the whole owl sits ~36 px left at f436–437 (beak x 1443/1450 vs 1479/1487), and at f446 the head is ~45 px right of the source's banked head.
defects.fix: In s02's owl layer: draw the cups as dark ovals (~40×75 px, fill ~#1c1c1c with rib highlights) and thicken the headband. Add two talon groups hanging ~35 px below the belly. Stroke a 2–3 px dark contour around the body and wings, and add chest feather scallops. Set OWL_SOFT0 = 0 and scale the OWL_SOFT table by ~0.5. Scale the flyFront body/head ×1.12. Pull the left wing-tip targets in by ~35 px. Re-fit the root x for 434–438 and the head bank at 444–448 from the source beak position.

defects.what: The room's tone fields are perfectly regular grids of round white dots, a mechanical halftone. The source uses hand cross-hatching: a woven line grid with irregular density and dark shapes such as picture frames. In the hold, the upper-left dot field is about 3× too bright (mean 9.4 vs 3.3 over x 0–700, y 140–420) and reads as a grey dotted rectangle where the source is near black. The carton faces also carry a fine dot halftone.
defects.fix: Replace mesh() in scratch.js with two-direction line hatching: 5–7 px jittered spacing, line width driven by value, slight angle noise, and some dark voids. Drop the hold's upper-left field to ≤4 mean, or remove it, keeping only the vertical post and hanging cables. Remove the dot texture from the carton faces.

defects.at: 14.44–16.2 hold (also visible 13.6–17.6 under pan and flight); room.js HOLD_WORLD
defects.what: The carton stack geometry is wrong. (a) The stack's left steps are missing. The source has a second-tier box at x≈540–817, y≈436–607 and a third-tier box at x≈474–805, y≈607–806; the render is black there, and at f340 the incoming cartons in the upper right (x≈1740–2206, y 0–550) are absent. (b) An open flap wedge was invented at x≈711–850, y≈440–590; the source box there is closed. (c) The far-right cartons have only a front face (x 1737–1878). The source's dark top and side faces and edge lines run to x≈2090, and the lower-tier outlines span x 1758–2100, y 670–946. (d) The board behind is a short bright streak at x≈1455–1706, y≈232–255 that looks like a floating white bar (left third mean 16 vs 9). The source board is long and dark, running to x≈2090. (e) The box faces are airbrushed gradients with glowing centres and drips from the top edges, with no ink edge lines. The source uses vertical streak hatching with dark ink edges and a light edge highlight. (f) The chair back at x≈584–750, y≈690–946 is only a thin arc; in the source it is a dark filled shape with a light rim. (g) The cables hanging behind the stack top (x≈970–1080, y 0–250) are missing, while long curved grey cables were added at x≈507–706, y≈100–380.
defects.fix: Add the two left step boxes. Replace the flap with a closed box. Extend the far-right boxes with dark top and side faces and 1–2 px light edge lines out to x≈2090. Lengthen the board to x≈2090 and darken it to a mean of ~4. Re-texture the faces with vertical streak hatching and dark contour strokes, and remove the glow gradients and drips. Fill the chair back. Move the cables to x≈970–1080.

defects.what: The designer is over-blurred in both pans. Sobel edge energy on the designer is 0.67–0.79 of the source's at f296–330 and f440–477 (e.g. f300: 29.5 vs 40.7). defects.what: The beanie crown is a smooth grey gradient with blotches, and the cuff ends have noisy salt-and-pepper patches. defects.what: The outer outlines of the hair masses are thresholded, traced outlines of averaged source frames. This is disclosed, but it sits close to the 'never embed any pixel of the source' rule.

defects.what: hyperframes snapshot (compare.sh) samples times on a floor(t*30)/30 grid. So 6.04, 11.56, 12.76, 13.96, 17.56, 18.76 and f/25+0.01 times such as 8.73, 16.93, 17.93, 18.93 render the previous 25 fps frame, and frame 151 (s02's first) can never be sampled: 6.0333 gives s01 and 6.0667 gives f152. The film renderer uses exact i/25, so the real cuts are correct: the s01→s02 step is 67.4 vs 69.3 in the source.
defects.fix: For frame-exact compares use t = round(1.2*f)/30 + 0.001.

verdict:
Timing and camera are close; the drawing is visibly simplified and in places off-model, so the honest rating is approx, not close.

**What matches:**
- **Eye scan:** the iris track is within 1 px of the source on every frame from 174 to 217.
- **Beats:** the snap (218–220), blink (380/381–389/390–392), crouch, take-off (405) and the camera stop at 361 all land within ±1 frame.
- **Camera:** the blurred error has its minimum at 0 frame offset through both pans, so the pan timing and path are frame-accurate.
- **Measured positions:** the pencil, teeth and laptop lid are within about 10 px.

**Error level (σ8 blurred MAE, frame-correct pairing, 229 frames):**

| section | mean |
|---|---|
| stare/look | 10.7 |
| outbound pan | 8.3 |
| hold | 6.1 |
| flight | 7.9 |
| return pan | 12.3 |
| overall | ~9.1 |

These agree with the builder's fidelity log, which is honest.

**Most visible gaps:**
1. The designer's face on the 4.5 s full-frame stare: heavy angry brows, no dark eye rings, almond eyes, a cartoon nose with black nostrils, and scribbled cheeks. The source is a gaunt, terrified manga face.
2. The flying owl: pale thin headphone cups, missing talons, lumpy outline-free wings, blurred with no ink contour, and about 12% too small.
3. The room's tone is regular round-dot halftone grids instead of hand cross-hatching, with over-bright dot fields in the hold.
4. The carton stack: its left step boxes are missing, a box flap was invented, and the far-right faces and the board are truncated.
5. Over-blurred designer in both pans, with edge energy at 0.67–0.79 of the source.
6. The return-pan beanie is a smooth gradient with speckle patches.
7. A visible style pop into s04 at 19.12. The source has no cut there, and s04 is also one frame ahead.

**Checks:**
- **Determinism:** 10 timestamps rendered in two separate runs were bit-identical.
- **Errors:** no placeholder text, error bars or console errors.
- **Hard rules:** no Math.random or Date and no image loads in s02.
- **Traced element:** the hair outlines are traced from the source (disclosed in the fidelity log).
